aaup.description:
Arab American University (AAUP), established in 2000, is the first private Palestinian university. Founded in collaboration with California State University and Utah State University, AAUP is committed to providing high-quality education through diverse academic programs.

The University promotes excellence in education, research, innovation, and entrepreneurship while providing a dynamic learning environment that supports student success. AAUP continues to advance its academic programs and facilities in accordance with international quality standards, preparing graduates to contribute to Palestinian and global development.
